board: Generic MTS-102 miniature toggle switch (SPDT ON-ON, 3 solder lugs L1/COM/L2 at 4.7 mm pitch, 6 A 125 VAC / 3 A 250 VAC, 1/4-40 (6 mm) bushing)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator L1=CLOSED then L1=OPEN, PCB DRC clean, footprint). The passive SPDT switch is modelled as a 1x2 keypad-matrix (COM row, L1/L2 columns; slider 1 = COM-L1, 2 = COM-L2, 0 = mid-travel), since digital-sensor needs a supply pin; ratings and SPDT ON-ON contact form come from the MTS series datasheet.
breakoutPinoutSource: MTS series datasheet SPDT 3P drawings (three lugs in a row at 4.7 mm, middle = common) and Fritzing core basic-toggle-switch.fzp pin order L1, COM, L2; seller listings (phippselectronics.com, sigmanortec.ro) confirm the 3-pin SPDT ON-ON MTS-102
